alias.match: ^aard layout( lock| unlock| save| forget| restore| list| help| reset)?( .*)?

muclient.script:
require "mw_theme_base" require "scrollbar" require "themed_miniwindows"
function OnPluginListChanged() dofile "lua/aard_requirements.lua" end
default_top = 139 default_bottom = 545 default_left = 7 default_right = 650
-- Variables not saved. startx = "" starty = "" posx = "" posy = "" hotspot_id = "" orig_height = 400 -- saves old height when we collapse window.
inputbar_marker_characters = 80 inputbar_poll_interval = 0.1 inputbar_fast_poll_duration = 0.1 inputbar_last_poll_time = 0 inputbar_fast_poll_until = 0 inputbar_active = false inputbar_attached = true inputbar_content_signature = nil inputbar_presentation_signature = nil inputbar_hidden_overhead = nil inputbar_native_height = nil inputbar_window = nil inputbar_rect = nil inputbar_logical_line_starts = {} inputbar_moving = false inputbar_auto_resize_suppressed = false inputbar_output_height = nil inputbar_output_width = nil inputbar_cursor_position = nil inputbar_selection_start = nil inputbar_selection_end = nil
require "serialize"
function LayoutHelp() print("") print("Aardwolf MUSHclient Layout Command Help") print("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------") print("aard layout lock : prevent dragging miniwindows") print("aard layout unlock : allow dragging miniwindows") print("aard layout save <keyword> : store the current layout as the given keyword") print("aard layout restore <keyword> : restore the layout for the given keyword") print("aard layout forget <keyword> : forget the layout for the given keyword") print("aard layout list : list all stored layout keywords") print("aard layout help : show this command help") print("aard layout reset : like resetaard, but better") print("aard input : toggle the movable synthetic input bar") print("") LockStatus() print("") end
function LockStatus() print("Current layout lock status:", ((GetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows") == "1") and "LOCKED") or "UNLOCKED") end
function LayoutCommand(name, line, wildcards) if wildcards[1] == " lock" then SetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows", "1") LockStatus() elseif wildcards[1] == " unlock" then SetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows", "0") LockStatus() elseif wildcards[1] == " save" then key = Trim(wildcards[2]) if key ~= "" then LayoutStore(key) else LayoutHelp() end elseif wildcards[1] == " restore" then key = Trim(wildcards[2]) if key ~= "" then LayoutRestore(key) else LayoutHelp() end elseif wildcards[1] == " list" then LayoutList() elseif wildcards[1] == " forget" then key = Trim(wildcards[2]) if key ~= "" then LayoutForget(key) else LayoutHelp() end elseif wildcards[1] == " reset" then reset_main() EnableAlias("resetaard", false) Execute("resetaard") EnableAlias("resetaard", true) elseif wildcards[1] == "" or wildcards[1] == " help" then LayoutHelp() end end
function InputBarFrameDifference() return math.max(0, (tonumber(GetInfo(263)) or 0) - (tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or 0)) end
function InputBarNativeHeight() return math.max( (tonumber(GetInfo(214)) or 1) + 4, tonumber(inputbar_native_height) or tonumber(GetVariable("inputbar_native_height")) or 0 ) end
function InputBarCurrentHeight() local native_height = InputBarNativeHeight() if not inputbar_rect or not WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return native_height end
local native_font_height = tonumber(GetInfo(214)) or 1 local lines = math.max(1, math.floor((native_height - 4) / native_font_height)) local text_height = lines * inputbar_rect.line_height local current_height = WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) local text_area_height = inputbar_rect.padded_bottom - inputbar_rect.padded_top - 1 local frame_height = current_height - text_area_height return math.max(native_height, text_height + frame_height) end
function InputBarDesiredAutoResizeHeight() if not inputbar_auto_resize_suppressed or GetOption("auto_resize_command_window") ~= 1 then return end
local height = tonumber(GetCommandWindowDesiredHeight(InputBarNativeHeight())) or 0 if height > 0 then return height end end
function InputBarSetAutoResizeSuppressed(suppressed) check(SetCommandWindowAutoResizeSuppressed(suppressed)) inputbar_auto_resize_suppressed = suppressed end
function InputBarHasRequiredAPIs() local required = { "GetCommandCursorPosition", "GetCommandWindowDesiredHeight", "SetCommandWindowAutoResizeSuppressed" } local missing = {} for _, name in ipairs(required) do if type(_G[name]) ~= "function" then table.insert(missing, name) end end if #missing == 0 then return true end
ColourNote( "white", "red", "Synthetic input bar unavailable. This MUSHclient build is missing: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")) return false end
function InputBarOutputGeometryChanged() local height = tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or 0 local width = tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or 0 local changed = inputbar_output_height ~= nil and (height ~= inputbar_output_height or width ~= inputbar_output_width) inputbar_output_height = height inputbar_output_width = width return changed end
function MainOutputBottomLimit() local limit = (tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or 7) - 7 if inputbar_active and inputbar_attached and inputbar_window and WindowInfo(inputBar, 5) then limit = limit - InputBarCurrentHeight() end return math.max(0, limit) end
function InputBarLoadFont() if not inputbar_rect or not WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return false end
local font_name = GetInfo(23) local font_size = tonumber(GetOption("input_font_height")) or 10 local font_weight = tonumber(GetOption("input_font_weight")) or 400 local font_italic = GetOption("input_font_italic") == 1 local font_charset = tonumber(GetOption("input_font_charset")) or 0 local changed = inputbar_rect:loadFont( font_name, font_size, { bold=font_weight >= 600, italic=font_italic, charset=font_charset, pitch_and_family=miniwin.font_pitch_default, reload_token=table.concat({GetInfo(214), GetInfo(215)}, ":") }) if changed then inputbar_content_signature = nil inputbar_presentation_signature = nil end return changed end
function InputBarUpdateWindowInfo(left, top) if not inputbar_window or not inputbar_window.windowinfo then return end inputbar_window.windowinfo.window_left = left inputbar_window.windowinfo.window_top = top inputbar_window.windowinfo.window_mode = 0 end
function InputBarSaveSettings() SetVariable("inputbar_attached", inputbar_attached and "1" or "0") if inputbar_native_height then SetVariable("inputbar_native_height", tostring(inputbar_native_height)) end end
function InputBarAttachedRectangle() local border_offset = tonumber(GetInfo(276)) or 0 local left = math.max(0, (tonumber(GetInfo(290)) or textrect_left) - border_offset) local right = math.min( tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or textrect_right, (tonumber(GetInfo(292)) or textrect_right) + border_offset ) local height = InputBarCurrentHeight() local top = (tonumber(GetInfo(293)) or textrect_bottom) + border_offset + 1 top = math.max(0, math.min(top, (tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or top + height) - height)) return left, top, math.max(1, right - left), height end
function InputBarEnsureWindow() if inputbar_window and WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return end
local left, top, width, height = InputBarAttachedRectangle() inputbar_window = ThemedTextWindow({ id=inputBar, default_left_position=left, default_top_position=top, default_width=width, default_height=height, is_temporary=false, resizeable=false, text_scrollable=false, text_selectable=false, text_copyable=false, url_hyperlinks=false, autowrap=true, text_font_name=GetInfo(23), text_font_size=tonumber(GetOption("input_font_height")) or 10, text_max_lines=0, text_padding=0, defer_showing=true, body_is_transparent=false, preprocess={ mousedown=InputBarMouseDown, mouseup=InputBarMouseUp, cancelmousedown=InputBarCancelMouseDown, dragmove=InputBarDragMove, dragrelease=InputBarDragRelease }, drag_cursor=miniwin.cursor_ibeam, drag_tooltip="Hold Alt and drag to move the input bar", show_scrollback_marker=false, text_selection_callback=InputBarSelectionChanged, column_guide=inputbar_marker_characters }) inputbar_rect = inputbar_window.textrect
inputbar_window.menu_table = {"Reset input bar"} inputbar_window.menu_handlers = {InputBarReset}
InputBarLoadFont() inputbar_window:hide() end
function InputBarCaptureAndHideNative() local before = InputBarFrameDifference() InputBarSetAutoResizeSuppressed(true) check(SetCommandWindowHeight(0)) local after = InputBarFrameDifference() local measured_height = before - after
inputbar_hidden_overhead = after if measured_height >= (tonumber(GetInfo(214)) or 1) then inputbar_native_height = measured_height else inputbar_native_height = tonumber(GetVariable("inputbar_native_height")) or (tonumber(GetInfo(214)) or 1) + 4 end SetVariable("inputbar_native_height", tostring(inputbar_native_height)) end
function InputBarMeasureAndHideNative() if not inputbar_active then return end if inputbar_hidden_overhead == nil then InputBarCaptureAndHideNative() return end
if inputbar_auto_resize_suppressed then local desired_height = InputBarDesiredAutoResizeHeight() if desired_height and desired_height ~= inputbar_native_height then inputbar_native_height = desired_height SetVariable("inputbar_native_height", tostring(inputbar_native_height)) end return end
local current_difference = InputBarFrameDifference() local measured_height = current_difference - inputbar_hidden_overhead if measured_height > 0 then if measured_height >= (tonumber(GetInfo(214)) or 1) then inputbar_native_height = measured_height SetVariable("inputbar_native_height", tostring(inputbar_native_height)) end check(SetCommandWindowHeight(0)) inputbar_hidden_overhead = InputBarFrameDifference() elseif measured_height < 0 then inputbar_hidden_overhead = current_difference end end
function InputBarRestoreNative() -- Output text can remain after the world windows are destroyed. if GetInfo(235) > 0 then check(SetCommandWindowHeight(InputBarNativeHeight())) end InputBarSetAutoResizeSuppressed(false) inputbar_hidden_overhead = nil end
function InputBarPositionAttached() if not inputbar_window or not WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return false end
local left, top, width, height = InputBarAttachedRectangle() local changed = WindowInfo(inputBar, 10) ~= left or WindowInfo(inputBar, 11) ~= top or WindowInfo(inputBar, 3) ~= width or WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) ~= height
if WindowInfo(inputBar, 3) ~= width or WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) ~= height then inputbar_window:resize(width, height) end if WindowInfo(inputBar, 10) ~= left or WindowInfo(inputBar, 11) ~= top then check(WindowPosition(inputBar, left, top, 0, miniwin.create_absolute_location)) end
inputbar_window.default_left_position = left inputbar_window.default_top_position = top inputbar_window.default_width = width inputbar_window.default_height = height return changed end
function InputBarPositionDetached() if not inputbar_window or not WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return false end
local width = math.max(1, WindowInfo(inputBar, 3)) local height = InputBarCurrentHeight() -- Keep the user-selected position in movewindow state. WindowInfo 10 and 11 -- can contain a temporary clamp while the available output area is smaller. local left = inputbar_window.windowinfo.window_left local top = inputbar_window.windowinfo.window_top left = math.max(0, math.min(left, math.max(0, GetInfo(281) - width))) top = math.max(0, math.min(top, math.max(0, GetInfo(280) - height)))
local changed = WindowInfo(inputBar, 10) ~= left or WindowInfo(inputBar, 11) ~= top or WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) ~= height
if WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) ~= height then inputbar_window:resize(width, height) end if WindowInfo(inputBar, 10) ~= left or WindowInfo(inputBar, 11) ~= top then check(WindowPosition(inputBar, left, top, 0, miniwin.create_absolute_location)) end return changed end
function InputBarRenderText(command) local rendered = command inputbar_logical_line_starts = {}
local line_start = 1 local position = 1 while position <= #command do local byte = command:byte(position) if byte == 10 or byte == 13 then table.insert(inputbar_logical_line_starts, line_start - 1) if byte == 13 and command:byte(position + 1) == 10 then position = position + 2 else position = position + 1 end line_start = position else position = position + 1 end end
table.insert(inputbar_logical_line_starts, line_start - 1) rendered = rendered:gsub("@", "@@") rendered = rendered:gsub("\r\n", "\n") rendered = rendered:gsub("\r", "\n") return rendered end
function InputBarSourceToWrapped(position) position = math.max(0, tonumber(position) or 0) local raw_line = 1 for index, line_start in ipairs(inputbar_logical_line_starts) do if position < line_start then break end raw_line = index end
local raw_offset = position - (inputbar_logical_line_starts[raw_line] or 0) local line, offset = inputbar_rect:raw_to_wrapped(raw_line, raw_offset) if line then return line, offset end
local last_line = math.max(1, inputbar_rect.num_wrapped_lines) return last_line, inputbar_rect:line_length(last_line) end
function InputBarWrappedToSource(line, offset) local raw_line, raw_offset = inputbar_rect:wrapped_to_raw(line, offset) if not raw_line then return 0 end return (inputbar_logical_line_starts[raw_line] or 0) + raw_offset end
function InputBarDraw(force) if not inputbar_active or not inputbar_window or not WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) then return false end
local command = GetCommand() or "" local selection_start = math.max(0, (tonumber(GetInfo(236)) or 1) - 1) local selection_end = tonumber(GetInfo(237)) or 0 local cursor_position local reported_position = (tonumber(GetCommandCursorPosition()) or 0) - 1 if reported_position >= 0 and reported_position <= #command and (selection_end == 0 or reported_position == selection_start or reported_position == selection_end) then cursor_position = reported_position end
if cursor_position == nil and selection_end == 0 then cursor_position = selection_start elseif cursor_position == nil and inputbar_selection_start == selection_start and inputbar_selection_end == selection_end and (inputbar_cursor_position == selection_start or inputbar_cursor_position == selection_end) then cursor_position = inputbar_cursor_position elseif cursor_position == nil then cursor_position = selection_end end inputbar_cursor_position = cursor_position inputbar_selection_start = selection_start inputbar_selection_end = selection_end
local content_signature = table.concat({ command, WindowInfo(inputBar, 3), Theme.PRIMARY_BODY, Theme.BODY_TEXT }, "\30") local content_changed = content_signature ~= inputbar_content_signature local presentation_signature = table.concat({ selection_start, selection_end, cursor_position, WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) }, "\30") if not force and not content_changed and presentation_signature == inputbar_presentation_signature then return false end inputbar_content_signature = content_signature inputbar_presentation_signature = presentation_signature
if content_changed then inputbar_window:clear(false) inputbar_window:add_text(InputBarRenderText(command), false) end local cursor_line, cursor_line_position = InputBarSourceToWrapped(cursor_position)
if selection_end > selection_start then local anchor_position = selection_start if cursor_position == selection_start then anchor_position = selection_end end local anchor_line, anchor_offset = InputBarSourceToWrapped(anchor_position) inputbar_rect:set_editor_selection( anchor_line, anchor_offset, cursor_line, cursor_line_position) else inputbar_rect:set_editor_selection( cursor_line, cursor_line_position, cursor_line, cursor_line_position) end
inputbar_rect:ensure_visible(cursor_line) inputbar_rect:set_cursor( cursor_line, cursor_line_position, selection_end == 0, false) inputbar_window:draw() InputBarStartFastPolling() return true end
function InputBarSelectionChanged(rect, state) if not inputbar_active then return end
local anchor = InputBarWrappedToSource(state.anchor.line, state.anchor.offset) local active = InputBarWrappedToSource(state.active.line, state.active.offset) check(SetCommandSelection(anchor + 1, active)) inputbar_cursor_position = active inputbar_selection_start = math.min(anchor, active) if anchor == active then inputbar_selection_end = 0 else inputbar_selection_end = math.max(anchor, active) end inputbar_presentation_signature = table.concat({ inputbar_selection_start, inputbar_selection_end, inputbar_cursor_position, WindowInfo(inputBar, 4) }, "\30") rect:ensure_visible(state.active.line) rect:set_cursor( state.active.line, state.active.offset, state.collapsed, false) inputbar_window:draw() InputBarStartFastPolling() end
function InputBarStartFastPolling() local now = utils.timer() inputbar_fast_poll_until = math.max( inputbar_fast_poll_until, now + inputbar_fast_poll_duration) end
function InputBarRefresh(force) if not inputbar_active then return end inputbar_last_poll_time = utils.timer() local old_height = InputBarCurrentHeight() InputBarMeasureAndHideNative() local height_changed = old_height ~= InputBarCurrentHeight() local output_changed = InputBarOutputGeometryChanged() local changed = InputBarLoadFont() local inputbar_drawn = false if inputbar_attached and (height_changed or output_changed) then if output_changed then inputbar_drawn = check_geometry() == true else inputbar_drawn = draw_main_window() == true end changed = true end if inputbar_attached then changed = InputBarPositionAttached() or changed else changed = InputBarPositionDetached() or changed end if not inputbar_drawn then InputBarDraw(force or changed) end end
function InputBarActivate(show_status) if inputbar_active then return end if not InputBarHasRequiredAPIs() then return false end
inputbar_attached = GetVariable("inputbar_attached") ~= "0" InputBarEnsureWindow() inputbar_active = true SetVariable("inputbar_enabled", "1") InputBarCaptureAndHideNative() InputBarOutputGeometryChanged() inputbar_window:show() if inputbar_attached then draw_main_window() else InputBarPositionDetached() end InputBarRefresh(false) if show_status then ColourNote("lime", "", "Synthetic input bar enabled.") end return true end
function InputBarDeactivate(persist_disabled, show_status) if not inputbar_active then if persist_disabled then SetVariable("inputbar_enabled", "0") end return end
InputBarSaveSettings() inputbar_window:hide() InputBarRestoreNative() inputbar_output_height = nil inputbar_output_width = nil if GetInfo(235) > 0 then check_geometry() end inputbar_active = false if persist_disabled then SetVariable("inputbar_enabled", "0") end if show_status then ColourNote("yellow", "", "Synthetic input bar disabled.") end end
function ToggleInputBar() if inputbar_active then InputBarDeactivate(true, true) else InputBarActivate(true) end SaveState() end
function InputBarReset() inputbar_attached = true SetVariable("inputbar_attached", "1") draw_main_window() local left, top, width, height = InputBarAttachedRectangle() inputbar_window.default_left_position = left inputbar_window.default_top_position = top inputbar_window.default_width = width inputbar_window.default_height = height inputbar_window:reset() InputBarUpdateWindowInfo(left, top) InputBarSaveSettings() InputBarDraw(false) SaveState() InputBarFocusNative() end
function InputBarFocusNative() check(DoCommand("ActivateInputArea")) end
function InputBarMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then return true end if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_lh_mouse) == 0 then return true end
if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_alt) ~= 0 then if GetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows") == "1" then return true end inputbar_rect:cancel_selection() InputBarUpdateWindowInfo( WindowInfo(inputBar, 10), WindowInfo(inputBar, 11)) inputbar_moving = true return false end
inputbar_moving = false InputBarFocusNative() InputBarDraw(false) inputbar_rect:begin_selection( flags, WindowInfo(inputBar, 14), WindowInfo(inputBar, 15), {word_separator_pattern="[^%w_]+"}) return true end
function InputBarDragMove(flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_lh_mouse) == 0 then return true end
if inputbar_moving then if inputbar_attached then inputbar_attached = false SetVariable("inputbar_attached", "0") draw_main_window() end return false end
inputbar_rect:update_selection( WindowInfo(inputBar, 14), WindowInfo(inputBar, 15)) return true end
function InputBarDragRelease(flags, hotspot_id) local was_moving = inputbar_moving if inputbar_moving then inputbar_attached = false SetVariable("inputbar_attached", "0") InputBarPositionDetached() movewindow.save_state(inputBar) InputBarSaveSettings() SaveState() inputbar_rect:cancel_selection() elseif inputbar_rect then inputbar_rect:finish_selection( WindowInfo(inputBar, 14), WindowInfo(inputBar, 15)) end inputbar_moving = false InputBarFocusNative() return not was_moving end
function InputBarCancelMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) inputbar_moving = false if inputbar_rect then inputbar_rect:cancel_selection() end return true end
function InputBarMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then inputbar_window:right_click_menu(hotspot_id) InputBarFocusNative() return true end InputBarFocusNative() return false end
function OnPluginCommandChanged() InputBarRefresh(true) end
function OnPluginTick() if not inputbar_active then return end
local now = utils.timer() local poll_interval = inputbar_poll_interval if now < inputbar_fast_poll_until then poll_interval = 0 end if now - inputbar_last_poll_time >= poll_interval then InputBarRefresh(false) end end
function OnPluginThemeChange() inputbar_content_signature = nil inputbar_presentation_signature = nil if inputbar_active then InputBarRefresh(true) end end
function FetchLayouts() loadstring("_layouts = "..(GetVariable("all_layouts") or "{}"))() return _layouts end
function LayoutList() all_layouts = FetchLayouts()
numlayouts = 0 for k,v in pairs(all_layouts) do numlayouts = numlayouts + 1 end
print("") if numlayouts > 0 then print("Available layout keys are:") print("--------------------------") for key,layout in pairs(all_layouts) do print(key) end else print("No layouts have been saved yet.") end print("") end
function LayoutForget(key) all_layouts = FetchLayouts() if all_layouts[key] then all_layouts[key] = nil SetVariable("all_layouts", serialize.save_simple(all_layouts)) print("Layout with key '"..key.."' has been forgotten.") else print("No layout found for key '"..key.."'.") end end
function LayoutStore(key) all_layouts = FetchLayouts() Repaint() -- update rendered miniwindow positions before saving miniwindows = WindowList() if miniwindows then current_layout = { ["aard_layout_trect"] = { ["trleft"] = textrect_left, ["trright"] = textrect_right, ["trtop"] = textrect_top, ["trbottom"] = textrect_bottom } } for _,mwid in ipairs(miniwindows) do current_layout[mwid] = { ["left"] = WindowInfo(mwid, 10), ["top"] = WindowInfo(mwid, 11), ["width"] = WindowInfo(mwid, 3), ["height"] = WindowInfo(mwid, 4) } end all_layouts[key] = current_layout SetVariable("all_layouts", serialize.save_simple(all_layouts)) print("Current layout stored as key '"..key.."'.") else print("No miniwindows found. Not saving layout '"..key.."'.") end -- if any end
function LayoutRestore(key) all_layouts = FetchLayouts() layout = all_layouts[key] if layout then -- do the main output rect trect = layout["aard_layout_trect"] textrect_left = trect["trleft"] textrect_right = trect["trright"] textrect_top = trect["trtop"] textrect_bottom = trect["trbottom"] SaveLayout() check_geometry() draw_main_window() Repaint() -- update rendered miniwindow positions before comparing -- do the other plugins CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "pause") -- repaint buffer plugin local plugins_to_reload = {} for mwid,rect in pairs(layout) do if mwid ~= "aard_layout_trect" then local pid = WindowInfo(mwid, 23) if pid and (pid ~= GetPluginID()) then if rect["left"] ~= WindowInfo(mwid, 10) or rect["top"] ~= WindowInfo(mwid, 11) or rect["width"] ~= WindowInfo(mwid, 3) or rect["height"] ~= WindowInfo(mwid, 4) then WindowResize(mwid, rect["width"], rect["height"], WindowInfo(mwid, 9)) WindowPosition(mwid, rect["left"], rect["top"], WindowInfo(mwid, 7), WindowInfo(mwid, 8)) plugins_to_reload[pid] = true end end end end Repaint() -- hack because WindowPosition doesn't immediately update coordinates for pid,_ in pairs(plugins_to_reload) do CallPlugin(pid, "SaveState") local a, b = CallPlugin(pid, "OnPluginThemeChange") CallPlugin(pid, "SaveState") if not ((a == error_code.eOK) and b) then CallPlugin(pid, "Theme.just_reloading") ReloadPlugin(pid) end end CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "resume") -- repaint buffer plugin print("Layout for key '"..key.."' has been restored.") else print("No layout found for key '"..key.."'.") end end
function ResizeMainCallback(flags) if (bit.band(flags, 0x20) ~= 0) or (GetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows") == "1") then return end end_startup_check()
local font_height = GetInfo(212) local MIN_SIZE = (12 * font_height) + 1
posx, posy = WindowInfo (textResizer, 17), WindowInfo (textResizer, 18) textrect_right = textrect_right + posx - startx startx = posx if ( textrect_right-textrect_left < MIN_SIZE) then textrect_right = textrect_left+MIN_SIZE startx = textrect_right elseif (textrect_right > GetInfo(281)-7) then textrect_right = GetInfo(281)-7 startx = textrect_right end
textrect_bottom = textrect_bottom + posy - starty starty = posy local bottom_limit = MainOutputBottomLimit() if ( textrect_bottom-textrect_top < MIN_SIZE) then textrect_bottom = math.min(textrect_top+MIN_SIZE, bottom_limit) starty = textrect_bottom elseif (textrect_bottom > bottom_limit) then textrect_bottom = bottom_limit starty = textrect_bottom end
if (utils.timer() - lastRefresh > 0.0333) then draw_main_window() lastRefresh = utils.timer() end end lastRefresh = 0
function DragMainCallback() if GetVariable("lock_down_miniwindows") == "1" then return end end_startup_check() posx, posy = WindowInfo (textDragger, 17), WindowInfo (textDragger, 18) local height = GetInfo(293) - GetInfo(291) local width = GetInfo(292) - GetInfo(290)
textrect_left = textrect_left + posx - startx textrect_right = textrect_left + width if (textrect_left <= 7) then textrect_left = 7 textrect_right = textrect_left + width elseif (textrect_right >= GetInfo(281)-7) then textrect_right = GetInfo(281)-7 textrect_left = textrect_right - width else startx = posx end
textrect_top = textrect_top + posy - starty textrect_bottom = textrect_top+height starty = posy local bottom_limit = MainOutputBottomLimit() if (textrect_top < 7) then textrect_top = 7 starty = textrect_top textrect_bottom = textrect_top+height elseif (textrect_bottom > bottom_limit) then textrect_bottom = bottom_limit textrect_top = textrect_bottom-height starty = textrect_top end
draw_main_window() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Called after the resize widget is released. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function ResizeReleaseMainCallback(flags) if bit.band(flags, 0x20) == 0 then SaveLayout() end draw_main_window() end
function DragReleaseMainCallback() SaveLayout() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Called when mouse button is pressed on hotspot. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function MouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) if (hotspot_id == textResizer.."_resize") then startx, starty = WindowInfo (textResizer, 17), WindowInfo (textResizer, 18) if bit.band(flags, 0x20) ~= 0 then local result = WindowMenu(textResizer, WindowInfo(textResizer, 14), WindowInfo(textResizer, 15), "!"..(GetInfo(120) and "+" or "").."Show exterior scrollbar -->") if result == "1" then SetVariable("hide_main_scroll", tostring(GetInfo(120))) SetScroll(-2, not GetInfo(120)) end end elseif (hotspot_id == "dragmain") then startx, starty = WindowInfo (textDragger, 17), WindowInfo (textDragger, 18) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Called when mouse moved away from hotspot. Doesn't really apply for draggables. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function CancelMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Called when mouse button released on hotspot. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function MouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Called when plugin is saved - store our variables for next time. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function SaveLayout() SetVariable("trleft", textrect_left) SetVariable("trright", textrect_right) SetVariable("trtop", textrect_top) SetVariable("trbottom", textrect_bottom) end
function SaveEnabled() SetVariable ("enabled", tostring (GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 17))) end
function reset_aard() reset_main() LayoutHelp() end
function reset_main() textrect_left = default_left textrect_right = default_right textrect_top = default_top textrect_bottom = default_bottom SaveLayout() check_geometry() draw_main_window() end

if type(Theme.bg_texture_function) == "function" then imgpath = Theme.bg_texture_function() end
if 0 ~= SetBackgroundImage(imgpath, 13) then imgpath = dir.."worlds\\plugins\\images\\bg1.png" -- add some theme coloring to the background WindowCreate("WiLl_It_BlEnD", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, Theme.SECONDARY_BODY) WindowLoadImage("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "tExTuRe", imgpath) local tw = WindowImageInfo("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "tExTuRe", 2) local th = WindowImageInfo("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "tExTuRe", 3) WindowResize("WiLl_It_BlEnD", tw, th, Theme.SECONDARY_BODY) WindowImageFromWindow("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "cOlOr", "WiLl_It_BlEnD") WindowDrawImage("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "tExTuRe", 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) WindowBlendImage("WiLl_It_BlEnD", "cOlOr", 0, 0, 0, 0, 12, 0.3)
imgpath = dir.."worlds\\plugins\\images\\temp_theme_blend.png" WindowWrite("WiLl_It_BlEnD", imgpath) WindowDelete("WiLl_It_BlEnD") end
if 0 ~= SetBackgroundImage(imgpath, 13) then ColourNote("yellow","red","Error loading background image.") end
local bgcolor = Theme.PRIMARY_BODY WindowCreate (bgwin, 0, 0, 0, 0, 12, 3, bgcolor) WindowCreate (bgoffscreen, 0, 0, 0, 0, 12, 3, bgcolor)
local logopath = dir .. "worlds\\plugins\\images\\aardbg13.png" if WindowLoadImage (bgoffscreen, "wolf_logo", logopath) == 0 then WindowResize (bgoffscreen, WindowImageInfo(bgoffscreen, "wolf_logo", 2), WindowImageInfo(bgoffscreen, "wolf_logo", 3), bgcolor) WindowDrawImageAlpha (bgoffscreen, "wolf_logo", 0, 0, 0, 0, Theme.LOGO_OPACITY) WindowImageFromWindow(bgwin, "wolf_logo", bgoffscreen) image_ratio = WindowImageInfo(bgwin, "wolf_logo", 2)/WindowImageInfo(bgwin, "wolf_logo", 3) end
WindowDelete(bgoffscreen)
-- if disabled last time, stay disabled if GetVariable ("enabled") == "false" then ColourNote ("yellow", "", "Warning: Plugin " .. GetPluginName ().. " is currently disabled.") check (EnablePlugin(GetPluginID (), false)) return end -- they didn't enable us last time
--- init display check_geometry()

function check_geometry() if not inputbar_active and (GetOption("auto_resize_command_window") == 1) and (GetCommand() == "") then SetCommandWindowHeight((GetOption("auto_resize_minimum_lines") * GetInfo(214)) + 4) end
local windowbottom, windowright = GetInfo(280), GetInfo(281) textrect_top = math.max(0, tonumber(GetVariable("trtop")) or default_top) textrect_bottom = math.min(windowbottom, tonumber(GetVariable("trbottom")) or default_bottom) textrect_left = math.max(0, tonumber(GetVariable("trleft")) or default_left) textrect_right = math.min(windowright, tonumber(GetVariable("trright")) or default_right) local inputbar_drawn = false if prevwindowbottom ~= windowbottom or prevwindowright ~= windowright then inputbar_drawn = draw_main_window() == true prevwindowbottom, prevwindowright = windowbottom, windowright end return inputbar_drawn end
function scrollMain(step) local new_pos = (step-1) * GetInfo(212) if new_pos ~= GetInfo(296) then SetScroll(new_pos, GetInfo(120)) end end
-- when something is added to output function OnPluginScreendraw(type, log, line) add_main_resizer() end
-- when output area moves function OnPluginDrawOutputWindow(a, b, c) if cur_scroll_position ~= GetInfo(296) then -- current position different from previous add_main_resizer() end end
function add_main_resizer() if textResizer == nil then return end local l = GetInfo(274) + GetInfo(276) local t = GetInfo(273) - GetInfo(276) - 1 local b = GetInfo(275) + GetInfo(276) + 1
cur_scroll_position = GetInfo(296) local total_output_lines = GetInfo(224) local text_rectangle_height = GetInfo(293) - GetInfo(291) local font_height = GetInfo(212) local text_rectangle_lines = math.ceil(text_rectangle_height / font_height) local cur_scroll_line = math.ceil(cur_scroll_position / font_height) + 1 local max_scroll_position = ((total_output_lines-1) * font_height) - text_rectangle_height if cur_scroll_position >= max_scroll_position then cur_scroll_line = total_output_lines - text_rectangle_lines + 1 end
if WindowInfo(textResizer, 1) then -- if it already exists --- Reposition the resize tag. WindowPosition(textResizer, l, t, 0, 18) WindowResize(textResizer, Theme.RESIZER_SIZE + 4, b-t, Theme.CLICKABLE) else -- Add another mini-window in bottom right corner for resizer tag. WindowCreate(textResizer, l, t, Theme.RESIZER_SIZE + 4, b-t, 12, miniwin.create_absolute_location, Theme.CLICKABLE ) end
if (prev_l ~= l) or (prev_t ~= t) or (prev_b ~= b) then il, it, ir, ib = Theme.DrawBorder(textResizer) -- allows textrectangle to be resized Theme.AddResizeTag(textResizer, "full", il, ib-Theme.RESIZER_SIZE+1, "MouseDown", "ResizeMainCallback", "ResizeReleaseMainCallback") prev_l, prev_t, prev_b = l, t, b end
if sb then sb:setRect(il, it, ir, ib-Theme.RESIZER_SIZE) else sb = ScrollBar.new(textResizer, "sb", il, it, ir, ib-Theme.RESIZER_SIZE, 30) sb:addUpdateCallback(self, scrollMain) end sb:setScroll(cur_scroll_line, text_rectangle_lines, total_output_lines) CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint")
WindowShow(textResizer, true) end
function add_title_dragger() -- Add mini-window at top with draghandler for dragging the main output around. dragsize = 15 border = GetInfo(277)+GetInfo(276)
WindowCreate(textDragger, GetInfo(272)-border, GetInfo(273)-border, GetInfo(274)-GetInfo(272)+(2*border), dragsize, 0, 22, GetNormalColour(1))
if WindowHotspotInfo(textDragger, "dragmain", 13) then WindowMoveHotspot(textDragger, "dragmain", 0, 0, 0, 0) else WindowAddHotspot(textDragger, "dragmain", 0, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil, "MouseDown", "CancelMouseDown", "MouseUp", "", 1, 0) WindowDragHandler(textDragger, "dragmain", "DragMainCallback", "DragReleaseMainCallback", 0) end
WindowShow(textDragger,true) end
function OnPluginWorldOutputResized() if inputbar_active then return end AddTimer("resizeCheckTimer1", 0, 0, .1, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary, "check_geometry") AddTimer("resizeCheckTimer2", 0, 0, 1, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary, "check_geometry") end
function draw_main_window() -- addresses a problem where new users are trying to play without the window maximized local t_right = math.min(textrect_right, GetInfo(281)-7-Theme.RESIZER_SIZE-4) local t_bottom = math.min(textrect_bottom, MainOutputBottomLimit())
TextRectangle(textrect_left, textrect_top, t_right, t_bottom, 5, -- BorderOffset, Theme.THREE_D_HIGHLIGHT, -- BorderColour, 1, -- BorderWidth, Theme.THREE_D_SOFTSHADOW, -- OutsideFillColour, miniwin.brush_solid) -- OutsideFillStyle
if GetPluginInfo("74524d1272786aaf04e9487d", 17) then -- splitscreen scrollback plugin force update CallPlugin("74524d1272786aaf04e9487d", "check_display") end
-- Add a mini-window under main text area so background won't mess it up. local trwidth = t_right - textrect_left local trheight = t_bottom - textrect_top
WindowCreate (bgwin, textrect_left - 5, textrect_top - 5, math.max(0, trwidth + 10), math.max(0, trheight + 10), 12 , 3, Theme.PRIMARY_BODY) WindowShow(bgwin, true)
if image_ratio ~= nil and GetVariable("nologo") ~= "1" then local rect_ratio = trwidth/trheight if rect_ratio > image_ratio then image_height = trheight image_width = trheight*image_ratio else image_height = trwidth/image_ratio image_width = trwidth end
WindowDrawImage (bgwin, "wolf_logo", (trwidth-image_width)/2, (trheight-image_height)/2, (trwidth+image_width)/2, (trheight+image_height)/2, miniwin.image_stretch) end
add_title_dragger() add_main_resizer() local inputbar_drawn = false if inputbar_active and inputbar_attached and WindowInfo(inputBar, 1) and WindowInfo(inputBar, 5) then if InputBarPositionAttached() then InputBarDraw(true) inputbar_drawn = true end end return inputbar_drawn end
